text:
maria: Heads up — ran a burst/soak against gpu-pool-7 around 10:30 and saw a p99 tail spike (~+120ms). Traces point at queue handoff / burst packing rather than kernel exec. I'm trialing a small 'token velocimeter' gate to smooth batch formation and reduce KV-priming thrash.

sam: Can you paste the config you're testing so I can repro locally?

maria: Sure, quick snippet i'm experimenting with:
```json
{
  \"queue_pacing\": \"velocimeter\",
  \"velocimeter\": {
    \"window_ms\": 30,
    \"ramp_factor\": 1.25,
    \"token_budget_max\": 16,
    \"min_flush_tokens\": 3,
    \"pool_scoped\": true
  },
  \"kv_priming_window_ms\": 40
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: maria/token-velocimeter -> staging at 2024-05-11T11:02 :rocket: (rollout id: r-9812)

li: Quick Q — is the gate applied before kernel-selection routing or after? If after we might end up starving super-short requests and push them to a slower path.

maria: It's pre-routing. The gate tweaks batch formation targets (tokens/sec per lane) so the kernel-selector receives a more stable batch shape. Keep in mind this is to avoid short pulses that force repeated KV priming and kernel affinity churn.

sam: From the profiler i saw `kv_evictions/sec` spikes lining up with those pulses. Suggest adding per-pool `kv_priming_window_ms=50` and a tiny hysteresis on the velocimeter so we don't oscillate.

li: Profiler excerpt i grabbed during the spike: `p95=42ms p99=190ms kv_hit=0.72 shard_mismatch=0.13`. The mismatch column is where we pay extra kernel-selection cost.

maria: After turning the gate on for a 30m run: p95 dropped ~18ms, p99 dropped ~42ms overall, but there was a small increase for long sequences (seq_len>800) where batching delayed execution a bit. Next tweak will be lowering `token_budget_max` and bumping `ramp_factor` to recover those.

sam: Proposal: token_budget_max->12, ramp_factor->1.4, and route requests with tokens<8 to microburst fast-path (bypass velocimeter). Also add a safety that disables the gate if kernel-selector `mismatch_rate` > 0.10 for >1m.

maria: Good plan. I'll run a 2h soak with those params and include a fallback flag: `velocimeter_enable_if_mismatch_lt=0.10`. If soak looks stable we can roll to canary.

li: Also add an observability tag to the batcher that records `velocimeter_bucket` in traces — will help correlate when we see regressions later.

maria: Will do. Posting soak logs when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
